# devin-internals-spec

> Documented map of Devin's local session stores — CLI `sessions.db`, Desktop `acp-messages/*.db` and `state.vscdb` — plus a schema-version detector and deterministic synthetic fixtures, so tooling fails loudly instead of silently misreading data.

Devin keeps everything on disk in undocumented SQLite databases whose schema changes without notice (sessions.db is at v17 and counting). This project documents the format — including the `refinery_schema_history` migration ledger, per-session `acp-messages` stores and `windsurfSpace.*` keys in `state.vscdb` — and ships a Python library (`devin_internals`) with typed, read-only parsers and `detect_schema_version()`, which returns a version contract and refuses unknown versions. It is the ground-truth layer that devin-qa-pack, devin-evals, devin-doctor and devin-memory build on.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-internals-spec/blob/main/README.md): full documentation
- [docs/SPEC.md](https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-internals-spec/blob/main/docs/SPEC.md): the spec — only items marked "verified" should be relied on

## Key commands
- `devin-inspect schema <sessions.db>`: print the schema-detection contract (JSON)
- `devin-inspect sessions <sessions.db>`: list sessions (id, title, cwd, …)
- `devin-inspect health <devin-data-dir>`: locate and check all three stores
- `pipx install "devin-internals-spec @ git+https://github.com/Icaro0310/devin-internals-spec.git"`: install
- `pytest`: run the test suite (dev install)

## Library usage
- `from devin_internals import detect_schema_version` → `detect_schema_version(path)` returns `{schema_version, known, min_supported, ...}` and raises on unknown versions
- `from devin_internals.parsers import SessionsStore` → `with SessionsStore(path) as s: s.sessions()` yields typed dataclasses

## When to use / when not
- Use when: building tools that read Devin's local stores; you need a schema-version gate that refuses loudly on unknown versions; you need deterministic synthetic fixtures to test parsers without real data.
- Not when: you want to export sessions (that's devin-history's job — this documents and guards the format, never dumps conversations); the Devin schema is newer than v17 (the detector refuses by design until the spec is updated); you need writes (strictly read-only).
